title: Transmission fluid overtemperature
plainEnglishMeaning: The PCM recorded a transmission-fluid overtemperature condition. The temperature must be confirmed because a biased sensor or grounded circuit can imitate overheating.
failureCriteria: The exact application-specific temperature and duration criteria are not yet verified.
falsePositiveConditions: A sensor or wiring fault can report high temperature when the fluid is not overheated.
confirmatoryTests: Stop strenuous driving and independently confirm transmission temperature.
Check fluid level and condition using the applicable service procedure.
Test the temperature sensor and its circuit if measured fluid temperature is normal.
safetyLevel: Stop and investigate if actual overheating is confirmed
